content:
A bench.
A photo from a walk on 15 June, 2024.
📷 OM-D E-M5 & 45 mm ƒ1.8, shot at ƒ13.

photos.alt: A photo of a bench made out of solid concrete in a single piece that looks a bit like a sofa. It stands amid tall grass, yellow flowers, ferns, and bushes. Behind all the vegetation, on the left of the frame, an ocean can be seen, with waves crashing, and a blue sky above. Between the ocean and the vegetation, there is some structure belonging to the power lines infrastructure visible.
